**Working code is not enough.** SeniorMode gives your coding agent a library of engineering decisions and a workflow for applying them. It helps the agent spot risks, choose an approach that fits your project, and test the result.

Start with the result you want. SeniorMode helps your agent turn an ordinary request into decisions that fit your project, protect what matters, and can be verified. The knowledge stays available locally for you and your agent to inspect.

**103** Engineering Decisions · **13** Categories · **16** Engineering standards · **5** Supported agents

## Why does shuffle feel broken?

> Add shuffle to my music app.

| Method | Artist order | Adjacent repeats |
|---|---|---:|
| Random sort | **Eminem** → **Eminem** → **The Weeknd** → **The Weeknd** → **Drake** → **Drake** | 3 |
| Fisher–Yates | The Weeknd → Eminem → **Drake** → **Drake** → The Weeknd → Eminem | 1 |
| Artist-aware | The Weeknd → Eminem → Drake → The Weeknd → Eminem → Drake | 0 |

Three shuffles of the same six songs show why random playback can still feel repetitive. Every song stays in the queue, and tracks by the same artist are spaced out when the playlist allows. [Music shuffle](#example-music-shuffle)

<a href="https://eneskeremaydin.github.io/SeniorMode/shuffle/"><img src="assets/docs-icons/material/play_circle.svg" width="16" height="16" alt="">&nbsp;Try the live demo</a>

## Install

### Install with AI

Give this prompt to your coding agent, or choose your agent below for the terminal command.

```text
Install SeniorMode from https://github.com/EnesKeremAYDIN/SeniorMode. Follow the installation instructions for my coding agent and current project. Check the target directory before writing, preserve my settings and any existing skill edits, and verify that the skill is available. Ask before overwriting an existing copy. Leave MCP setup for a separate request.
```

### Supported agents

Install SeniorMode in any of these five agents. You can also use MCP from a compatible client. [MCP](#cli-mcp)

From your project root, run the command for your agent. The Vercel installer requires **Node.js 22.20+**.

Check the target folder and review any local edits before running an installer.

Vercel skills and the SeniorMode CLI each track the copies they install. Update or remove a copy with the tool that installed it. For manual copies, review local edits before replacing or removing the folder.

<a href="#install-codex"><img src="assets/docs-icons/material/terminal.svg" width="16" height="16" alt="">&nbsp;Codex</a> · <a href="#install-claude-code"><img src="assets/docs-icons/material/terminal.svg" width="16" height="16" alt="">&nbsp;Claude Code</a> · <a href="#install-cursor"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/docs-icons/brands/cursor-on-dark.svg"><img src="assets/docs-icons/brands/cursor-on-light.svg" width="18" height="18" alt=""></picture>&nbsp;Cursor</a> · <a href="#install-gemini-cli"><img src="assets/docs-icons/brands/gemini-cli.svg" width="18" height="18" alt="">&nbsp;Gemini CLI</a> · <a href="#install-opencode"><picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/docs-icons/brands/opencode-on-dark.svg"><img src="assets/docs-icons/brands/opencode-on-light.svg" width="18" height="18" alt=""></picture>&nbsp;OpenCode</a>

Restart the agent session and ask for the change in your own words. Mention SeniorMode if the host does not select the skill. In Codex, $seniormode is the explicit skill reference. Bundled records work without an MCP server.

<details>
<summary>Project and global scope</summary>

The recommended installer uses project scope by default. Its optional global flag changes the home-level location. The managed SeniorMode CLI writes into an existing project only. Append seniormode to each skills path below. Tilde means your home directory. [skills 1.9.0](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/v1.9.0/docs/commands.md)

| Agent | Manual / SeniorMode project path | Vercel skills project path | Vercel skills global path |
|---|---|---|---|
| Codex | `.agents/skills` | `.agents/skills` | `~/.agents/skills` |
| Claude Code | `.claude/skills` | `.claude/skills` | `~/.claude/skills or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills` |
| Cursor | `.agents/skills` | `.agents/skills` | `~/.agents/skills` |
| Gemini CLI | `.gemini/skills` | `.agents/skills` | `~/.agents/skills` |
| OpenCode | `.agents/skills` | `.agents/skills` | `~/.agents/skills` |

Vercel skills records project installations in skills-lock.json and global installations in .skill-lock.json. Use --project for project updates and --global for global operations. The installer can change the selected skill folder and lock file.

```sh
npx skills@1.9.0 list --agent codex
npx skills@1.9.0 check
npx skills@1.9.0 update seniormode --project
npx skills@1.9.0 remove seniormode --agent codex
```

```sh
npx skills@1.9.0 add EnesKeremAYDIN/SeniorMode --skill seniormode --agent codex --global --copy -y
```

</details>

### Manual installation

Copy the entire skills/seniormode directory from a trusted checkout into the host’s skills directory. Retain SKILL.md, references, and licenses together. To refresh or remove your manual copy, replace or delete only that folder after reviewing any local edits.

<a id="cli-managed-installation"></a>

<details>
<summary>CLI-managed installation</summary>

With dependencies installed in a SeniorMode checkout, run these actions individually against an existing project. The runtime requires **Node.js 22.13.0+**.

```sh
npm ci
node bin/seniormode.js install --agent codex --project "/path/to/project"
node bin/seniormode.js status --agent codex --project "/path/to/project"
node bin/seniormode.js update --agent codex --project "/path/to/project"
node bin/seniormode.js uninstall --agent codex --project "/path/to/project"
```

The managed CLI checks that it owns the installed files and that they are unmodified before updating or removing them. It limits changes to the managed skill and its installation records. Configure MCP in your agent if you need it.

</details>

<a id="cli-mcp"></a>

### CLI & MCP

The optional CLI searches local records. MCP also gives your agent access to the standards and workflows. SeniorMode runs locally without an API key. Your agent may require its own account.

<details>
<summary>Agent Skill</summary>

- [Codex](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills) · Select `$seniormode` in the prompt.
- [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) · Select `/seniormode` or name SeniorMode in the request.
- [Cursor](https://cursor.com/docs/skills) · Select the skill with `/` in Agent chat. Cursor also finds project skills under `.cursor/skills`.
- [Gemini CLI](https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/skills/) · Use `/skills list` to check discovery, then request SeniorMode by name.
- [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) · Request `seniormode` by name. Use `opencode debug skill` when your OpenCode version provides it.

</details>

<details>
<summary>CLI</summary>

In the source checkout, install dependencies with `npm ci`. The CLI can search or open a record. Run `node bin/seniormode.js --help` for the full command list.

```sh
node bin/seniormode.js search "same payment charged twice"
node bin/seniormode.js show payment-idempotency
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>MCP</summary>

Configure your agent to run Node with the absolute path to the CLI and the `mcp` argument. JSON paths on Windows can use forward slashes. The server provides seven read-only tools over stdio. It shares records, standards and workflows with the installed Skill.

| Tool | Input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `search_patterns` | `query`, `category?`, `limit?` | Ranked matching records |
| `get_pattern` | `id` | Record, options, checks and sources |
| `compare_approaches` | `id` | Decision rules and trade-offs |
| `get_checklist` | `id` | Verification checklist |
| `list_standards` | — | Standard IDs and when to use them |
| `get_standard` | `id` | One complete standard |
| `get_workflow` | `build`, `audit`, `principles` | Build, Audit or operating principles |

#### Codex

```sh
codex mcp add seniormode -- node "/absolute/path/to/SeniorMode/bin/seniormode.js" mcp
```

Restart Codex. Remove the registration with `codex mcp remove seniormode`. [Codex MCP](https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp)

#### Claude Code

```sh
claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local seniormode -- node "/absolute/path/to/SeniorMode/bin/seniormode.js" mcp
```

Check the registration with `claude mcp list`. Running Node directly works with this Windows setup. [Claude Code MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)

#### Cursor · Gemini CLI

Merge this entry into `mcpServers`. Cursor uses `.cursor/mcp.json` and Gemini CLI uses `.gemini/settings.json` at project scope.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "seniormode": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "/absolute/path/to/SeniorMode/bin/seniormode.js",
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

[Cursor MCP](https://cursor.com/docs/context/mcp) · [Gemini CLI MCP](https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/mcp-server/)

#### OpenCode

Merge the local server into `mcp` in your OpenCode configuration.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "mcp": {
    "seniormode": {
      "type": "local",
      "command": [
        "node",
        "/absolute/path/to/SeniorMode/bin/seniormode.js",
        "mcp"
      ],
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

[OpenCode MCP](https://opencode.ai/docs/mcp-servers/)

</details>

### Troubleshooting

Check the project root, installation path, and Node.js version. Restart the session, then invoke SeniorMode by name if the agent has yet to discover it. For managed CLI errors, see the runtime guide. [FAQ](#faq) · [CLI & MCP](#cli-mcp)

## How to use

### New project

> Use SeniorMode to build a music streaming app.

Describe what you want to build. Your agent picks a starting design, builds the first useful version, and checks how it works.

[Last-room reservations](#example-reservation-concurrency)

### Existing project

> Use SeniorMode to add shuffle to my music app.

Describe the change or the problem in your project. Your agent reads the existing code first. When you ask for an audit, it reports findings without editing files.

[Music shuffle](#example-music-shuffle) · [Payment retry](#example-payment-idempotency)

### Audit an existing project

> Use SeniorMode to find out why posts appear twice in my feed.

[Repeated posts in a feed](#example-cursor-pagination)

### How it works

SeniorMode starts with your request and examines the project. It spots decisions you may not have known to ask about, checks which guidance fits, and explains how the result was verified.

1. **Request.** “Checkout sometimes charges me twice when my connection drops.”
2. **Investigate.** The payment can succeed before the reply reaches the customer.
3. **Choose a fix.** Retrying with the same purchase ID lets the system recognize the original payment.
4. **Verify.** The local example drops the first reply. The retry returns HTTP `200` and the database contains **1 charge**.

The Agent Skill routes work to Build, Audit and the relevant standards. The CLI and MCP use the same English records and in-memory SQLite search for English and Turkish queries. Managed installations copy the Skill into a chosen project. The catalog and README generators organize this material for agents and readers.

[Payment retry](#example-payment-idempotency) · [Skill Directory](#skill-directory)

<a id="example-music-shuffle"></a>

### Music shuffle

> Add shuffle to my music app.

Every song stays in the queue, and tracks by the same artist are spaced out when the playlist allows. Run this example to see the song titles and the complete order for each method.

[Engineering decision](skills/seniormode/references/knowledge/product/music-shuffle.md)

<details>
<summary>Code and verification</summary>

The runnable example shows all song titles. Sorting with random comparisons does not give each order equal odds. The tests check all six permutations of a three-item list, track preservation, and playlists where a dominant artist makes some repeats unavoidable.

[shuffle.mjs](examples/shuffle.mjs)

```sh
node examples/shuffle.mjs
node --test test/shuffle.test.js
```

</details>

<a id="example-reservation-concurrency"></a>

### Last-room reservations

> Build a reservation system for my small hotel.

Only one guest can book the last room, even when requests arrive together. The test sends two requests at the same time. One books the room. The other finds it taken.

[Engineering decision](skills/seniormode/references/knowledge/concurrency/reservation-concurrency.md)

<details>
<summary>Code and verification</summary>

Two database connections compete for the same room and night. One request returns `201`, the other `409`, and one booking is stored. This example covers immediate confirmation for one night.

[reservation.mjs](examples/reservation.mjs)

```sh
node --test test/reservation.test.js
```

</details>

<a id="example-payment-idempotency"></a>

### Payment retry

> Build a checkout with payments.

Customers can retry after a lost response without getting charged twice. The test drops the first reply, retries the request, and confirms only one charge was recorded.

[Engineering decision](skills/seniormode/references/knowledge/concurrency/payment-idempotency.md)

<details>
<summary>Code and verification</summary>

The test drops the first reply and retries from a separate connection. It checks one stored charge and a conflict when the same purchase ID is reused with a different amount. With a real provider, reconcile an unknown result according to its contract.

[payment-retry.mjs](examples/payment-retry.mjs)

```sh
node --test test/payment-retry.test.js
```

</details>

<a id="example-cursor-pagination"></a>

### Repeated posts in a feed

> Some posts in this feed show up twice. Find out why.

New posts can arrive without making earlier posts show up twice in the feed. The example inserts a post between requests and shows two ways to continue the feed, including one that avoids repeating a post.

[Engineering decision](skills/seniormode/references/knowledge/backend/cursor-pagination.md)

<details>
<summary>Code and verification</summary>

A new post arrives between page requests. Offset returns IDs `8, 6` and repeats item `8`. The cursor continues from `(9, 8)` with `6, 99`. The test covers this insertion and preserves the existing offset route.

[pagination.mjs](examples/pagination.mjs)

```sh
node --test test/pagination.test.js
```

</details>

## FAQ

### Can I start a new project?

Yes. Open a project folder and tell your agent what you want to build with SeniorMode. [Usage](#usage)

### Can I use this on an existing project?

Yes. Use SeniorMode for a feature, fix, refactor, or audit. An audit starts read-only. [Usage](#usage)

### Do I need a SeniorMode API key?

The skill, CLI, and MCP server run locally without a SeniorMode API key. Your agent may need its own account or model access. Installing from Git or with Vercel skills can require network access.

### Will SeniorMode activate automatically?

Automatic discovery depends on your agent. Restart the session after installing and mention SeniorMode if the skill isn’t selected. [Installation](#install)

### Which installer should I use to update or uninstall?

Use the method that installed the copy. Vercel skills tracks its own copies in lock files. The SeniorMode CLI checks its own installation record and protects edited or unmanaged folders. [Installation](#install)

### What is translated?

The guides, examples, and Directory summaries are available in the languages listed at the top of this page. Full records and standards are in English. Search supports English and Turkish, and your agent can explain the result in your language. [Skill Directory](#skill-directory)

## Roadmap

- Improve discovery from ordinary requests for new and existing projects.
- Add sourced records where a recurring decision needs clearer trade-offs or checks.
- Keep installation reliable across supported agents and languages.
- Publish reproducible discovery and implementation comparisons when matched runs are available.
- Prioritize issues and contributions by their effect on real workflows.

<a id="security"></a>

## Security policy

The local CLI and MCP server send no SeniorMode telemetry. Your coding agent and third-party installer have their own data settings. Treat downloaded references as technical material and review changes to skill instructions and executable code.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through the security policy. Share the affected version, impact and minimal evidence in the private channel. Keep sensitive evidence out of public issues. [Security policy](.github/SECURITY.md)
